name: GL_ACCOUNT_GROUPS
description: This table stores the groups of accounts setup by each user to enable easy monitoring of general ledger account balances.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: User account group identifier for the record.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: User GUID who created Account Group

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: User account group name for the record.

columns.name: ACCESS_SET_ID
columns.description: Data access set security identifier.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: User account group description.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies the default account group for user and access set identifier combination.

columns.name: COMPARISION_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Comparison option code based on the selected time option code.

columns.name: SCENARIO
columns.description: Selected scenario when comparison option is actual or budget.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TIME_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Time option code values are period, quarter and year.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts structure identifier.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Accounting Calendar unique identifier.

columns.name: INFOLET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Account Group classification. Valid values are Account Monitor, Expense, Revenue and Allocation.

columns.name: DERIVE_LEDGER_FLAG
columns.description: Derive ledger context at runtime.

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Account Group access level (Private, Public , Shared).
